steps.what: Guide the actual aircraft to its designated area using hand signals, batons or other authorized methods while observing the surroundings
inputs: actual aircraft movement and surrounding conditions
outputs: aircraft guided to the designated area

tasks.design: Keep aircraft guidance with the attendant. An allocation view in {OPS_SYSTEM} can support a different information task but does not replace actual observation and signaling here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance depends on actual movement and clearances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing allocation information does not establish a replacement for this physical guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize a changing obstruction or misunderstanding immediately.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the actual surroundings and communicate clearly with the flight crew.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: aircraft guidance by signals depends on actual aircraft movement and surrounding conditions.

assumptions: Boundary is actual guidance using existing authorized methods. The statement establishes no separate record write, report or dispatch send; none is invented.
The designated area is an existing operational input; no new structured capture or sensing system is assumed. Native allocation views do not remove signaling.
No change means no upkeep. The full share denotes the whole task, not measured guidance duration.
unknowns: Whether local guidance includes a distinct stand-allocation lookup
research_questions: Observe and separately measure any actual allocation lookup or record action rather than fold it into signaling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual aircraft guidance remains fully retained; no distinct administrative action is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss incoming and outgoing aircraft by radio

steps.what: Radio flight dispatchers or other personnel to discuss actual incoming or outgoing aircraft and clarify operational information

tasks.design: Keep the live aircraft discussion on existing {TELEPHONY}. Native flight status information may support separate reference work, but does not establish less radio clarification in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The exchange concerns actual and changing aircraft movements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing live communications already connect personnel.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve ambiguous or conflicting information promptly.
tasks.human_edge: Ask for clarification and confirm shared understanding.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live radio discussions require personnel to clarify actual operational information.

assumptions: Boundary is the specified live radio discussion. No independent authored dispatch message, record write or report is specified; service forms are modeled separately.
Inputs are actual situation and messages; no new structured record is required. Native status views cannot be assumed to remove the discussion.
No change means zero upkeep; whole task time remains retained.
unknowns: Whether a separate dispatch entry occurs during local radio work
research_questions: Observe any distinct dispatch record and separate it from the actual radio exchange.

incremental.description: No introduced system or recording work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live aircraft discussion stays fully retained; separate service-form work is assessed below.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Complete forms from actual aircraft-service work

steps.what: Identify the actual aircraft-service tasks completed, quantities and exceptions from the attendant's own work
inputs: attendant's actual service actions and observations

steps.what: Complete and finish checking the service form with the actual task details and aircraft reference
Save the completed service form in the same service system

tasks.design: Configure a native aircraft-service form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse the assigned aircraft and service identifiers and offer task fields. The attendant supplies actual completion details and finishes checking the completed form before saving; assigned tasks are never automatically marked done.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated identifiers and form headings add typing to actual completion reporting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-linked forms can reuse existing service references.
tasks.still_hard: A planned task or prefilled field may be mistaken for an actual completed action.
tasks.human_edge: Record what really happened, including incomplete work and exceptions.

ambition.what: No automated service certification or aircraft release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: aircraft-service forms can reuse assigned job identifiers, while actual completion must come from the person doing the work.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is aircraft ground-service management. Boundary covers the statement's completion forms, including actual detail capture, form completion and save; no operational release or external send is performed.

Dispatcher supplies assigned aircraft and service ID; attendant supplies actual task, completion status, quantity and unit where relevant, time and exceptions in s1. Missing facts are manually resolved or marked incomplete; no hidden sensor or structured completion source is assumed.
Native form configuration first. Shares are provisional and only repeated identifier/form entry changes. Checking stays in ordinary form completion, with no new self-approval step.
Same-system save has 1% fully retained and earns no saving. Gross 7.8 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 7.3 net.
unknowns: Current form configuration and actual repeated-field burden
research_questions: Can native forms reduce entry without converting assigned service actions into false completion claims?

already_counted.description: Complete and check actual aircraft-service details

incremental.description: Maintain service-form fields and job references

approvals.approved_version: complete checked service form at end of s2; edits require renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if identifiers and task fields are already reused; up to 5% when exceptions reduce central 7.3% net.
